text: Ines and Chen's housewarming is Saturday at 7. Bring something veggie, Chen doesn't eat meat. They finally got the flat on Mill Road.
Dong broke his wrist at football on Sunday. Cast for six weeks, he's gutted because he can't drive. Should drop round with some food at the weekend
liam + sana engaged!! he asked her on the beach in portugal last week. engagement drinks the 14th at half 8
Ahmed's dad back in hospital, chest infection this time. Ahmed sounded exhausted on the phone. Ring him tomorrow evening to see how his dad's doing.
Tunde invited me to his 40th, Friday 7th at 8pm, upstairs at the Crown. Wife is Ayesha. Apparently he wants a decent bottle of rum, wouldn't say no to Kraken
Note to self: pick up the suit from the dry cleaners Thursday morning before Ricardo's wedding.
so Layla's little boy has had chickenpox all week and now she's got it too, poor thing. Matteo's been doing everything. remind me to send her something nice

Teresa and Gustavo — 25 years married on the 3rd. Party at their place the Saturday after. Teresa said Gustavo's been planning a surprise trip to Lisbon but she's not supposed to know. Their daughter Ruby is flying back from Toronto for it, landing the Thursday before. Teresa wants me to do a toast at the party, nothing long. Gustavo collects old vinyl, jazz mostly.
Suzanne's mum had a fall. Hip op Tuesday afternoon, then rehab for a few weeks. Suzanne is staying with her the night before
Dinner at Ana and Rohan's cancelled, Rohan's got flu. Rescheduling for sometime next month.

Oisín's sister Freya is getting married in Galway in June. He's best man and absolutely terrified of the speech. Told him I'd read a draft. He's going over the week before to help with the barn, then the stag is the weekend after that in Dublin. His girlfriend Zeynep isn't keen on him being away so much. Need to send him that speech book by Friday.
Kemal mentioned his daughter's been off school with tonsillitis, second time this term. They're seeing a specialist on the 22nd at 10.
Hugo and Ruby's wedding: ceremony 2pm, reception straight afterwards at the barn. Need to RSVP by Friday and say I'm coeliac.
Kofi tore his ACL playing five a side. surgery not till January. he's pretty down about it, missing the half marathon. check in on him next week
Aleksander's engagement party was great. Giulia's family flew in from Turin for it. Her nonna made the cake.

Had a long chat with Hassan after the dinner. His wife Phoebe has been struggling since the miscarriage in the summer. He doesn't really know what to do. They've got their wedding anniversary on the 30th and he wants to take her somewhere quiet, maybe the Lakes. I said I'd send him the cottage we stayed in. Also he's started cycling to work, which he's weirdly into now.
Helen's 60th — Sunday lunch, 1pm, the Swan. Her son Reza is organising. Must get a card the day before.
Rebecca's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, all fine. She was a wreck that morning though.
zeynep yilmaz housewarming sat. she said dont bring wine they have loads, plants would be better
Ines rang. Her grandad died on Monday. Funeral's Thursday at 11 in Porto, she flies out the day before. Text her that morning.
Chen Tanaka — Chen's fiancé is Dong, not Liam, I keep mixing them up. Wedding is next September.

Big dinner at Matteo's on the 12th. I'm doing dessert. Starts at half 7. Matteo's invited his new colleagues from the hospital too, and his brother Kemal is coming down from Edinburgh that morning. One of them is allergic to nuts, so no frangipane. Probably a tiramisu, Matteo loves tiramisu.
Ahmed said Sana's back is still bad, physio twice a week now. She can't sit for long so the cinema plan's off

Tunde Okafor and Layla, anniversary dinner Friday. He's booked the place they had their first date. Ask him how it went on Monday. Last year he forgot it completely and she didn't speak to him for two days, so he's gone all out this time: flowers in the morning, the restaurant at 8, and a weekend in Whitby booked for the month after.
Gustavo's son Hugo has glandular fever, been in bed nearly a fortnight. Gustavo is worried he'll miss his mocks.
Got the invite for Suzanne and Kemal's wedding through today. October 2027! Save the date.
remember to buy flowers for Ana tomorrow morning, she's home from hospital that afternoon
Rohan — loves board games, has about two hundred of them. Hosting a games night Saturday from 6. His partner Ayesha does the food.
Oisín, Ois to everyone, had his appendix out Wednesday night. Discharged the next day. Back at work already, idiot.
Freya's housewarming got called off, the move fell through at the last minute. She's gutted. Should take her out for a drink this week.

voice note. um so Kofi's mum is having chemo again, starts on the 4th, every other Tuesday morning. he's going to take her to the first one and then his brother Aleksander does the rest. he said he's fine but he really didn't seem fine. I need to message him the day after the first session.
Need to book a taxi for Giulia's party, Saturday 9pm till late.
Hassan & Phoebe's 10th anniversary. Tin. Something tin.
Helen's husband is in for a knee replacement on the 18th at 8am. She's driving him in and staying for the afternoon. Offer to walk their dog Pepper that day.
Reza mentioned his engagement's off. Didn't push it. He's moving back in with his parents for now.
rebecca smith bday drinks fri 7pm @ the Fox, plus her sister Zeynep's leaving do the week after
Ines is pregnant!! Due in April. Morning sickness has been awful though, she's barely eating. Chen is over the moon.
Dong's mum got the all clear from her scan this morning. Massive relief for the whole family.
Liam's dinner party Saturday. Ahmed, Sana and the kids are coming too. Liam asked me to come early, around 6, to help set up.
Wedding fair with Tunde on Sunday at 11. He wants a second opinion on venues.

Notes from the call with Ricardo: his wife Teresa got her MS diagnosis confirmed last week. They're taking it one day at a time. Neurologist appointment on the 9th at 2. He's asked me not to mention it to the others yet. Their anniversary is the following weekend and he still wants to do the dinner, says it'll be good for her. I should drop off a meal the day after the appointment.
Layla's niece is getting christened next Sunday morning. Layla's godmother and very nervous about the reading.
Matteo's 30th surprise party — he can't find out. Sat 19th, 8pm, Giulia's flat. Arrive by half 7. Chip in for the record player.
Suzanne said her son Gustavo is in hospital with pneumonia. He's only 4. They kept him in overnight and he should be home tomorrow afternoon.
Bins out tonight. Recycling too.

Ana's parents celebrating their golden anniversary in Madeira next month. Whole family going, she's dreading the flight. She's had a horrible fear of flying since a bad landing years ago and she's thinking of getting something from the GP for it. Her dad Hassan wants everyone to renew vows at the same chapel on the anniversary itself, the 15th at noon. Ana thinks it's a bit much. I should ask her about it when she's back.
rohan banerjee proposed to ayesha last night!! she said yes obviously. text them congrats in the morning
Kemal's back from his honeymoon on Thursday. Ask about Japan.

Hugo sprained his ankle at the wedding dancing. Ruby said the next morning he couldn't put weight on it. They went to A&E that afternoon and waited about six hours. Not broken, just badly sprained, but he's on crutches for a fortnight and has had to pull out of the 10k on the 2nd. Ruby's taking the week off to look after him.
Freya Andersson invited us to Christmas dinner at hers. Her partner Kofi is vegan, so not doing the pigs in blankets.
Grabbed coffee with Aleksander. He's thinking of proposing to Giulia at New Year. Asked me to keep it quiet. Ring is from his gran.
Phoebe's dad had a mild stroke on Friday. He's stable. She's going up to Leeds the day after tomorrow and staying the week. Don't forget to call her Friday evening.
Helen loves gardening, especially roses. She's been on about getting a greenhouse for ages, could be a good one for Christmas.
Reza's housewarming tomorrow at 4. Dr Fischer from his work will be there.
Rebecca rang about the hen do. March, Bath, spa weekend. She's chief bridesmaid for Zeynep and stressing about the budget.
Matteo's grandma's 90th on Sunday afternoon, lunch at the Italian place. He asked if I'd take photos afterwards.
Ahmed's wife Sana had the baby yesterday morning! Girl, 7lb 2. Both doing well. Ahmed says no visitors till next week. Send flowers.
Theatre Thursday evening, then early night. Dentist Friday 9am.

Party at Dong's tonight was lovely. His girlfriend Ines did all the cooking, she's training to be a chef. Need to return his casserole dish. Also met her brother Aleksander, who's just got engaged himself, and her mum, who's recovering from a hip replacement and was still walking with a stick. Lovely evening, stayed till nearly 1.
Uncle Tunde's knee is playing up again, he cancelled his retirement do because he can't stand for long. Aunt Layla says he's grumpy. Visit Sunday afternoon.
